units: <cite ref="Shabbat 156b:3">Sabb. 156ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ משונה</he> an unnatural death; <he>מ׳ עצמה</he> natural death.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 68a:4">Snh. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>אם ימותו מִיתַת עצמן</he> if they shall die a natural death.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:4">Ib. XI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 89a:3">89ᵃ</cite>) <he>מ׳ בב״ד</he> death at the hand of the court.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 5a">Snh. 5</cite> <he>מִיתָתוֹ בידי אדם</he> he must be put to death by man (court); <he>מיתתו בידי שמים</he> he shall be put to death by the Lord.
<cite ref="Ketubot 37b:8">Keth. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ אריכתא</he> one continued act of execution (comprising lashes and putting to death); a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִיתוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:1">Snh. VII, 1</cite> <he>ארבע מ׳ נמסרו לב״ד</he> four forms of capital punishment have been entrusted to the courts.

<cite ref="Sotah 8b:2">Sot. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>דין ארבע מ׳ וכ׳</he> the divine judgment taking the place of the four forms of capital punishment (which the Jewish courts can no longer decree) has not ceased; a. fr.
